strongest_candidate.reason: A direct proof-scope extension using unchanged GDT1287 certificate; independently reviewed by source_bindings. It requires no new native census or parameter fitting.
strongest_candidate.precise_gain: Infinite-state fixed updates injective on their common full forward orbit need not be surjective. Finite injective self-maps already are bijective, so no new finite-state class is excluded.
strongest_candidate.retained_limit: Only a common start and common natural whole-word endpoint, fixed working units and boundaries. Noninjective updates and arbitrary resets remain outside.

other_decision_changes.possible_change: An exact weighted upper bound on globally null sign mass, conditional on every retained group having nonempty payload. Does not decide context-dependent or null-only cover words.
other_decision_changes.smallest_check: Source-bound strict cache supports and unit frequencies, readers separate; optimize fixed null subsets with independently verified certificate.

other_decision_changes.possible_change: Absence of any nontrivial circular binary cut excludes all nontrivial K-class single-circular-block partitions, allowing arbitrary cuts and field order. A surviving cut establishes only compatibility.
other_decision_changes.smallest_check: For each nontrivial unit subset C require at most one exit C to complement around each whole group; complement symmetry reduces duplicate cuts. No source semantics or within-field sorting.
